title: Right-click Folder system switch
description:
PipeShare right-click now shows a third Folder system menu beside Quick actions and Admin tools. Admins who can use the Folder system bar can switch Customer ↔ Employee Wasabi scopes in one click without leaving the explorer.

Who is affected: PipeShare BASE after deploy; SaaS after Push. Same permission gate as the Folder system dropdown (not line-only DAS employees).
changeLog: Add third right-click panel: Folder system.
One-click Switch to Customer / Switch to Employee file spaces.
Current scope is marked and disabled so you always see where you are.
